overall_reason: A small token layer (--color-ink, --color-paper, --radius-2xl, --s, a Tailwind v4 theme) sits under rules that type nearly every size, gap and radius as literals, with 19 radii and 22 shadow recipes and muted ink at three alphas.

score.reason: T-HARDCODE fails on spacing, type and radius that are 93 to 94% literal with 138 spacing literals equal to tokens (TOK-006), and T-VALUE-INVENTORY on 19 radii and 22 shadows (TOK-004); the feature art is treated as illustration.

findings.evidence: declarations.by_family: spacing 403 literal against 15 var, font size 191 against 6, radius 90 against 1, colour 197 literal against 249 var; distinct_literal_colours 118. literal_retypes_a_token_value: spacing 138 (.btn gap 8, .nav-links gap 24, .tabs padding 4), colour 51 (.btn-dark #ffffff, .cells #140a05/0.06), radius 17 (.nav and .nav-panel 16px).
findings.before: The chrome types values the tokens already hold
findings.after: Nav, buttons, tabs and cells read --s, --radius-2xl, --color-ink and --color-paper
findings.why: With 94% literals the tokens do not govern the page; any change is a search-and-replace.

findings.where: nav, GitHub pill, work tabs, install button, code copy, work frame; 1440 and 375 (tiles/1440-00.png)
findings.evidence: values.1440.radius has 19 values: nav 16, GitHub button 11, work tab (#work-tab-0) 10, install copy button 7, .code-copy 8, .work-frame 26, .tc 28, plus 5, 6, 9, 20, 22. Shadows run 22 recipes with 11 one-offs; card_kit finds three recipes on 20px, 16px and 999px containers.
findings.before: Controls at 7, 8, 10 and 11px; frames at 16, 26 and 28px
findings.after: Three radii (control, panel, pill) and two shadows
findings.why: Neighbouring radii on controls side by side read as accidents.

findings.where: nav, sponsors row, hero lede; 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: values.1440.font_size has 23 sizes (the type_ladder sweep counts 27 with half steps 10.5 to 15.5). In the chrome: nav stars 14px, sponsors 'hang' link 14.5px, nav links 15px, sponsor names 17px, hero lede 19px. font_size on_token_share is 0.0.
findings.before: Body-range sizes in half-pixel steps, none on a token
findings.after: Four body steps as tokens (for example 13, 15, 17, 19) and the half sizes snapped to them
findings.why: Half-pixel steps cannot be seen as hierarchy.

findings.evidence: values.1440.colour_text shows muted ink as #1a0e08 at /0.62 (#sponsors-label, 68), /0.58 (23) and /0.66 (4). colour_fill.near_duplicates groups #f8f4ee (#directions), #f3eee7, #fff0e6, #fff6ef and #f6f6f4 within 0.018 OKLab, and #eadfd3 with #ecdccf.
findings.before: Three alphas for muted text; five cream surfaces
findings.after: One muted-ink token; one or two cream surface tokens
findings.why: Same-job values a hair apart are drift the next edit copies.

strengths: One family set (Google Sans Flex and Google Sans Code) and a core palette named --color-ink and --color-paper; 55% of colour declarations use var().
not_investigated: The feature art (feat-float fragments: search, KPI and chart mock-ups) and the tablet frames showing generated sites are illustrations or exhibits; only 68 elements were left out by the table, so some half-pixel sizes and off-scale spacing come from them.
The .dark class declares 3 names and redefines none of 16 semantic colours; it does not act as a theme and was not judged as one.
Visitor mode inferred as Persuade (a design-skill product page); no contract.
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no contract and no supplied design system or token file, so drift from a system could not be judged.
Inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles, not which rule or inline style set a value.
Token source files (Sass, JSON token files, Figma variables) behind the shipped CSS were not available.
States the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus, dialogs): their values were not in the table.
